subject: Ledgerly Hosted API evaluation — compact demo & availability
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha@ledgerly.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick evaluation request — Hosted API (sandbox access)

Hi Ben,

I just signed up for the Hosted API evaluation (self-serve) and would love a short walkthrough focused on latency/cost tradeoffs for our use case. We're a small ML infra team at Ledgerly building financial document ingestion and ranking — mostly 1–2k token prompts, real-time-ish responses.

Can we do a 20–25 minute quick demo this week? I'm in US/Eastern (NY) and generally available after 11:30am ET. Also would appreciate temporary sandbox credits so we can exercise embeddings + generate end-to-end.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
Head of ML Platform
Ledgerly

--
Sent from my phone

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@ledgerly.ai>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick evaluation request — Hosted API (sandbox access)

Hi Aisha — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for signing up and for the context on tokens/latency — that helps. We can absolutely do a 20–25 minute focused session to walk through:
- Hosted API quickstart (auth + sample calls)
- Performance & cost knobs (batching, sequence length, quantization suggestions)
- How to provision short-lived sandbox credits and sandbox endpoints for your team

Proposed times (your TZ = ET):
- Tue 8/10, 11:30am–11:55am ET
- Tue 8/10, 3:00pm–3:25pm ET
- Wed 8/11, 1:00pm–1:25pm ET

Diego (cc) will own the calendar invite and ops handoff; Grace (cc) will include a short pre-demo checklist and provision sandbox credits after the call. If none of these work, tell us your best two slots and we'll move things around.

I'll keep it tight — demo + 5–10 mins for next steps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise SDR Lead
Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
www.redwoodinference.com

Hi Ben — thanks for the options. Quick heads-up: Tue morning is tight for us — several folks have calendar blocks. The Tue 3pm ET option is OK, but could we shift 15 minutes earlier to 2:45pm ET? That would let two engineers join before another recurring standup.

Also: could you confirm the sandbox credit size (approx. token budget) and whether embeddings will be enabled on the evaluation endpoint? We want to exercise both features in the 25 minutes.

If 2:45pm ET is not possible, we can do Wed 1pm ET but prefer the earlier slot on Tue.

Thanks — Aisha
